claim: § The Threshold's Own Conatus: the refractory period after an action potential is 'functional specification', not recovery cost — during absolute refractory no stimulus of any magnitude fires the cell, during relative refractory only suprathreshold stimuli recruit it — and 'this graduated recovery creates a preference structure: the threshold will cross for stimuli that have earned the crossing in relation to its current state.'

pieces.what: A spiking threshold with an absolute and a relative refractory period, driven by a train of stimuli whose strengths and timings the reader sets and sees. The walk: one threshold with no refractory period (every suprathreshold stimulus crosses); then the absolute period (the same train, some crossings refused by timing alone); then the relative period (crossings refused by strength-at-this-moment). The test last: the claim is that the preference is the refractory structure's, so the piece removes it and shows the preference vanish — the same train, scored by which stimuli cross, with and without the structure. The verdict rule (what pattern of crossings counts as a 'preference structure', and what would count as none) is stated before the first run. Both arms scored; the model's time constants named as the model's, not a neuron's.
pieces.walks_up_from: one threshold, one stimulus, no memory
